falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at a new all-time high and the engine blowoff score prints above 70 within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed melt-up breaks the bottom_2024_aug analog and turns UNKNOWN/HOLD into a late-cycle blowoff, so flat is the wrong call

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 and high-yield OAS widens by more than 150 bps from today's level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear capitulation/risk-off regime resolves UNKNOWN into an actionable stress signal, so HOLD is invalidated

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year UST yield moves more than 40 bps and SPX moves more than 5% in the risk-off direction (yields up, equities down) or risk-on direction (yields down, equities up) over the same 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A joint rates-equity regime break supplies a directional macro verdict, proving the current UNKNOWN/HOLD call false

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
